risk_note: RV2 (orders + app.module; BR-FUND-22). Platform-restore detection: inside the order update transaction, after the CAS write, a VOID / CLAWED_BACK sub-order whose reason is REFUND / RIGHTS / COMMISSION_ZERO, or whose entry event into that status is PLATFORM_INVALID / INVALID_AFTER_SETTLE, and that the platform restores (P9 INVALID -> PAID / RECEIVED / SETTLED, or a commission column moving from <=0 / null to >0) registers one platform_restore recon diff through the orders-declared PlatformRestoreDiffPort; app.module implements the port with ledger registerReconDiffOnce (type platform_restore, source R1, refType order) and wires it into the worker via OrdersModule.forWorker, so orders never imports ledger. One diff per void / clawback episode (ref_id and dedupe key carry the entry history row id; the key builders are exported from orders domain so settlement B2-04zb can reuse them); expected_fen = the restored union commission, actual 0 (display only; ADMIN_RESTORE recomputes); warn alert only when newly inserted, without the sub-order id; PUNISH / BLACKLIST voids are not registered. rebate_status and ledger entries are not written. Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude in two rounds (r1 fail S1x3 -> round 2 added REFUND-alone, commission boundary and worker wiring tests) plus one mechanical kit type commit. Test-machine full verify hit the 3600 s container limit (exit 124) with no failure in the log; per D10-319 the CI verify-int decides. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
